interface.signature: def smallestWindow(S: str, P: str) -> str:

preconditions.description: Both S and P are strings.
Lengths of S and P are between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in S) and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in P)
preconditions.description: All characters in S and P are lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (return_value in S and all(S.count(c) >= P.count(c) for c in set(P)) and len(return_value) == min((len(S[i:i+len_w]) for i, len_w in enumerate((len(S[i:]) for i in range(len(S))) if all(S[i:i+len(S[i:])].count(c) >= P.count(c) for c in set(P)) else [float('inf')])) for _ in [1]))
postconditions.description: If a valid window exists, return_value is the shortest substring of S containing all characters of P (with required multiplicities); if multiple exist, it is the one with the smallest starting index. If no such window exists, return_value is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (return_value in S and len(return_value) > 0)
postconditions.description: If not '-1', the returned string is a non-empty substring of S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(S[S.find(return_value):S.find(return_value)+len(return_value)].count(c) >= P.count(c) for c in set(P))
postconditions.description: The returned substring contains at least the count of each character required by P.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or not any((S[i:i+len(return_value)] in S and all(S[i:i+len(return_value)].count(c) >= P.count(c) for c in set(P)) and (len(S[i:i+len(return_value)]) < len(return_value) or (len(S[i:i+len(return_value)]) == len(return_value) and i < S.find(return_value))) for i in range(len(S) - len(return_value) + 1)))
postconditions.description: No shorter valid window exists, and no valid window of the same length starts earlier.
